author: Astrokillah
text:
So USDJPY at this moment, is a good time to put the ENGULF Theorem to test!

Price reached FL A, bounced and engulfed B, then it dropped back to A
with several strong bearish candles. Most people would be dreadful to go
 long there. But miraculously, our theorem worked! FL A held price
almost to the pip at the MPL.

So the theorem says, price should reach the next FL, which is C, before it can come back to break A.

At this moment, ITs is making a double bottom at A, so next time it
comes down to A again, for sure it's going to break it. I also noticed
that there is a small DP just below C, so price may stop right there.
But we should not have too much faith in our prediction, our job is not
to predict, we simply trade what PA tells us.. As Master IF and also
Salivan used to say, price will get to FL (target) and THEN decide what
to do next. Until an FL is engulfed, we have no PA.

GBPAUD

I am now convinced, that the best way to learn FL is to following just
one or two charts LIVE... see how FLs are created, engulfed, created.

I still have half of my short trade open on this. But then I saw that
there is an opportunity to scalp something, so with my faith in RTM, I
went long on a LTF FL and netted another +3R.

So basically, I see A as a PCP, it was engulfed and created an FTR B

FTR B hit a target C and became FL, and it went on to engulf C but without touching FL D.

D is an LSK, I think price just have to hit it.

So when price dropped and returned to B, what do I do? I went long, with my target at D.

And it worked...it did make me SWEAT a little. Because after my long got
 triggered, price went so close to break below B, but each time, it held
 price up, price just had to hit D before it can be happy!

Thank you RTM, thank you Master IF!!!

author: Astrokillah
text:
I noticed something, when price makes a Rally-Base-Drop, the first
kink you saw on the right shoulder, is often a strong supply zone. I
want to see price drop some significant distance below this kink,
because this will prove to me that this kink is the 'origin' of the down
 move. And hopefully within this kink, we will find a nice, clean DP
that has never been touched before. So when price return to this clean
DP, it will often hold and push price down again. Then it's up to us to
manage our trade properly, do not assume price will travel far, all we
can be sure of is, price is likely to travel to the next opposing kink.

In my chart above, at 1, that pink LSK, I would not short there, because
 I see price didn't drop far enough, it dropped to the blue FL and
immediately bouncing up. So I wouldn't touch trade there at all. But if
price plunged, breaking the blue and the pink FLs below, and then
retrace back up to that kink, I might trade it, if I see a clean DP
inside.
